name: Tusker Minerals Ltd
summary: Tusker Minerals Ltd, a Perth company incorporated in 2022, was formerly DY6 Metals Limited. It discovers and assesses mineral deposits, concentrating on Southern Malawi for heavy rare earths, niobium, copper and nickel. It fully owns projects such as Machinga, Salambidwe, Ngala Hill, Tundulu, Mzimba and Karonga.
